The campus budget risk calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the weighted-risk logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.82 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.26s. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should re-check the specific weighting constants to ensure they align with evolving campus risk profiles.
